Mn-Nb catalysts can be used for Hg0 removal at low temperature and low concentration of HCl.
the Mn-Nb composite material can be used as an excellent catalyst for the removal of mercury from coal-fired flue gas.

the Mn-Nb composite catalytic material has a good catalytic effect on the removal of Hg0,and it has a good resistance to sulfur,especially when the capacity of Mn-Nb is 7%(w),and cerium oxide modified is 1.5%.
